Every `retrieve` hit carries `score` plus a full `features` object (`bm25`, `tier`/`tier_mult`, `aggregator`/`aggregator_mult`, `quality`/`quality_mult`, `age_days`/`recency_mult`, `chunker_ver`); `score` is always the product of the four multipliers and `bm25`, so the feature log reproduces `score` by construction. Ranking weights live in a checked-in config (`feed/config/retrieval-ranking.json`) and ship at `mode: "bm25"` (every multiplier forced to `1.0`, `score === features.bm25`); flipping to `mode: "weighted"` is gated on a hand-labeled gold nDCG@10 benchmark, whose harness is built but whose owner labeling pass and ship decision are not (Feed ADR-0011). `retrieve` attaches a per-provider `coverage` block (ADR-0009: retrieval never triggers acquisition) and a live `corpus` echo (article/chunk counts, latest scan, chunker version) on every response, since reads are never pinned to a snapshot. `coverage` describes article scans only; live-post acquisition has no separate coverage ledger. `deref` resolves a chunk ref or article ref back to its exact source span or article body (ADR-0004), and `revisions` returns an article's superseded-body history (ADR-0005).
